# CurrencyScoop

CurrencyBeacon is a developer friendly, easy-to-use REST API with real-time and historical exchange rates for fiat currencies and cryptocurrencies.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/currencyscoop/.

## Actions

- **Convert Currency** (read-only): Perform a single currency conversion from one currency to another for a specified amount.
- **Get Currencies** (read-only): Retrieve all supported currencies including their names and countries.
- **Get Historical Exchange Rates** (read-only): Retrieve historical exchange rate data for past dates going back to 1996.
- **Get Latest Exchange Rates** (read-only): Get real-time exchange rates for all supported currencies with a specified base currency.
- **Get Timeseries Exchange Rates** (read-only): Retrieve historical exchange rates for a given time period between start and end dates.
